mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, followee_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (follower_id, followee_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM follows f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND f2.followee_id = u.id ) AS isFollowing FROM follows f INNER JOIN users u ON f.followee_id = u.id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
